name: Red Dead Redemption
overview: Red Dead Redemption is an action-adventure Western video game developed by Rockstar San Diego and published by Rockstar Games. Set in the declining years of the American frontier in 1911, the story follows former outlaw John Marston, who is forced by government agents to hunt down the remaining members of his old gang in exchange for his family's freedom. As Marston journeys across the American West and Mexico, he confronts betrayal, redemption, and the end of the Wild West era.
